# CANDIDATE: DGCI_POSITIVE_GAMMA_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

High dealer net gamma concentration (positive gamma) creates a stabilizing “gamma‑wall” that tends to push price back toward VWAP on dips. We aim to capture the mean-reversion tendency when price dips to VWAP in a positive gamma environment, using EMA ribbon and volume conditions to filter for high-quality dips.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When DGCI (weighted net gamma) is above its 80‑day 80th percentile AND price pulls back to within 0.2% below VWAP AND the EMA ribbon shows a brief dip but remains overall bullish (EMA8>EMA21>EMA34) AND the dip candle has a bullish close (close>open) with volume > 1.2× 20‑day average, enter long at the close of the dip candle.
Exit shape: Stop set at the low of the dip candle or 1.5 ATR below entry (chart‑stop); TP1 at 1.2R, runner trails using a 10 % chandelier exit.
